service.description: Generate a test certificate with RUT extension for testing purposes using BouncyCastle
Create a complete test organization with DTE configuration, certificate with RUT extension, and CAF

field-map.value: Test DTE Certificate with RUT Extension

actions.script: import java.text.SimpleDateFormat // Generate test CAF XML with current date String today = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").format(new Date()) String rutSinDv = rut.split("-")[0] String cafXml = """ ${rut} ${organizationName} 33 1 100 ${today} ${Base64.encoder.encodeToString("test-modulus-${System.currentTimeMillis()}".bytes)} Aw== 300 ${Base64.encoder.encodeToString("test-signature-${System.currentTimeMillis()}".bytes)} """
